description: Sample Dataset for Building Energy Consumption and Solar Irradiation is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Anindhita Dewabharata, Shuo-Yan Chou (National Taiwan University of Science and Technology). This record provides a sample subset of the multivariate time-series dataset used for forecasting building energy consumption and solar irradiation. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
